entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Support'.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit customer support, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, Sarah. I... I need to return something. My order number is VF-881-209.
I can certainly look into that for you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloPro cycling shoes. What specifically is the issue with them?

I just... I'm so disappointed. I tried everything to make them work. I adjusted the cleats multiple times, wore different socks, but they keep giving me terrible blisters on my heels. I can't even finish a short ride.
Oh, that sounds incredibly uncomfortable. I'm sorry to hear they're causing you so much trouble.

It is. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I was so excited for these. With some unexpected bills coming up, I was really hoping I could still get a refund. That money would help so much right now.

I completely understand. Let me check the purchase date and our policy for you. I see you're one of our VIP members, and we definitely want to make this right. Okay, it looks like the shoes were delivered 58 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that refund for you, no problem at all.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you, Sarah. I was so worried it had been too long.

Not at all. I'm happy to help. For the trouble with the blisters, and as a thank you for being such a loyal member, I've also added a $15 credit to your account for your next purchase. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to your email now. Just pack the cycling shoes in the original box and drop it off at any post office.
Wow, that's so kind of you. You've really turned my day around. Thank you again.
You are very welcome. Your refund will be processed as soon as we receive the item. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
